bio: As you follow the road from Sarentino up to an altitude of 1 622m, you slowly become aware of the extraordinary experience offered by Terra - The Magic Place. Immersed in a natural wooded setting of beech and fir, this restaurant boasts delightful views at every turn, with breathtaking vistas of the Dolomites once you reach the sunny Alpine pasture in which the restaurant is situated. This is where the Schneider family began their adventure back in 1940 when Grandfather Johann built his first mountain hut here – the early origins of this magical place. The cuisine is served on a single tasting menu featuring small, beautifully presented dishes, all served at a good pace.
